hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-elm-lappwa.slogan: A 241 km loop out of Hannover east edge
hannover-lower-saxony-escapes-elm-lappwa.story: Open sweepers, old towns and enough bends to make it worth the start. 241 km round from Lehrte - plan on about 5 h of riding. The stops in between: Peine, Königslutter Elm road and Helmstedt old town stop. Schöningen ridge is the high point. The line favours views over speed.

sections.advice: Use Hannover east edge → Peine fuel gate as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.
sections.photoQuery: Hannover east edge Peine fuel gate Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: This Peine fuel gate → Königslutter Elm road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
sections.photoQuery: Peine fuel gate Königslutter Elm road Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Königslutter Elm road → Helmstedt old town stop is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.
sections.photoQuery: Königslutter Elm road Schöningen ridge Hannover / Lower Saxony escapes

sections.advice: Helmstedt old town stop → Schöningen ridge can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.
